technique_name: How can machine learning models be evaluated?
description: Machine learning models can be evaluated using performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Additionally, models can also be evaluated using insights from a confusion matrix, which provides information about false positives and false negatives and can help identify which types of errors a model is making.
